usa: DOJ release Nov 5, 2026: Federal Jury Convicts Dominican Republic Man of Illegally Reentering the United States after having been Deported
text: DOJ Nov 5, 2026, as posted: St. Thomas, USVI – U.S. Attorney Adam F. Sleeper announced today that a federal jury convicted Joan Manuel Tavarez Bueno, 34, of the Dominican Republic, for re-entry of a removed alien pursuant to 8 U.S.C. § 1326(a). After a three-day trial, the defendant was convicted as charged. The defendant, a citizen of the Dominican Republic, was previously removed from the United States as an illegal alien from Miami, FL.

name: Fidel Antonio Cruz Cruz
crime: Convicted: An illegal alien from Honduras who returned to the United States after being deported was sentenced today to eight months in federal prison. Fidel Antonio Cruz Cruz, age 32, a citizen of Honduras illegally present in the United States and residing in the Cedar Rapids, Iowa, area received the prison term after a June 8, 2026, guilty plea to one count of illegal reentry into the United States after having been convicted of a felony offense.
usa: DOJ release Nov 5, 2026: Illegal Alien Sentenced to Prison for Reentering the United States After Being Deported Six Times
text: DOJ Nov 5, 2026, as posted: An illegal alien from Honduras who returned to the United States after being deported was sentenced today to eight months in federal prison. Fidel Antonio Cruz Cruz, age 32, a citizen of Honduras illegally present in the United States and residing in the Cedar Rapids, Iowa, area received the prison term after a June 8, 2026, guilty plea to one count of illegal reentry into the United States after having been convicted of a felony offense. At the guilty plea, Cruz Cruz admitted he had previously been deported from the United States and illegally reentered the United States without the permission of the United States government. Cruz Cruz was previously deported five times between 2017 and 2019. In 2020, Cruz Cruz was convicted of illegally reentering the United States and sentenced to 76 days in prison. He was then deported for the sixth time.

name: Sebastian Higuera-Fuentes

usa: ICE release Nov 5, 2026: ICE arrests illegal alien who claimed to work for Washington state
entered: Entered Feb. 6, 2019, as posted; overstayed after Aug. 5, 2019.
text: ICE Nov 5, 2026, as posted: SEATTLE — ICE Seattle arrested an illegal alien from Kenya claiming to work for the Washington State Department of Children, Youth and Families during a targeted enforcement operation Oct. 26. Stanley Robert Kengu Muthee, first entered the U.S. on Feb. 6, 2019, and was required to depart no later than Aug. 5 that year. Instead, he remained in the country unlawfully, applying for and receiving work authorization three times under the Biden administration. When ICE officials questioned Muthee, the Nairobi native also claimed to have worked previously in Washington state corrections. Officers served him with a warrant of arrest and he will remain in ICE custody pending removal proceedings.
